usage: run_all.py [-h] [--execute | --dry-run] [--resume] [--retry-failed]
                  [--archive-incomplete] [--cohort-size COHORT_SIZE]
                  [--cohort COHORT_PATH] [--state STATE] [--events EVENTS]

Checkpointed orchestration for the standardized benchmark pipeline. This
module only coordinates the maintained runners; it does not implement
training, cache generation, explanation, or summary science.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --execute             Run preprocessing, training, explanations and summary
                        (expensive).
  --dry-run             Print commands only; create nothing (default).
  --resume              Validate/reuse completed runs; not epoch-level resume.
  --retry-failed        Retry failed commands, stopping again on any failure.
  --archive-incomplete  Preserve incomplete run/set under attempts/ before
                        restarting from scratch; requires --resume --retry-
                        failed and no active workers.
  --cohort-size COHORT_SIZE
                        Expected explanation subjects (default: 500).
  --cohort COHORT_PATH
  --state STATE
  --events EVENTS
